payload.title: AMD GPU Kernel Optimization Framework Overview
payload.summary: AMD GPU kernel development has multiple tiers of toolchains:

sections.heading: Framework Lineage
sections.gist: AMD GPU kernel development has multiple tiers of toolchains:

sections.heading: FlyDSL
sections.gist: FlyDSL (Flexible Layout Python DSL) is built on the MLIR compilation stack, using FLIR (Flexible Layout IR)—a CuTe-inspired (Shape, Stride) layout algebra.

sections.heading: TileLang
sections.gist: TileLang uses "Tile" as the fundamental programming unit, providing declarative GPU programming that supports both AMD and NVIDIA.

sections.heading: Composable Kernel (CK)
sections.gist: CK is AMD's C++ template library that provides composable high-performance GEMM, Attention, and other kernels, similar to NVIDIA CUTLASS.

sections.heading: ROCm 7.2 Key Features
sections.gist: - **ThinLTO**: Cross-file optimization, supporting function inlining, specialization, and dead code elimination - **rocMLIR FP4 Support**: New precision format for CDNA4 - **FP8 Extension**: Full compiler and graph stack support
